# Area: SEO (`seo`)

Whether search engines can find the site.

| Rule | Default severity | What to check |
|---|---|---|
| `seo.missing-title` | high | Pages without a `<title>`. |
| `seo.pipe` | low | A cell with an escaped \| pipe. |

## Facts to record

- `seo.sitemapUrl`: sitemap location.
- `seo.languages`: languages of the site.
